# Simple Harmonic Motion

A pendulum in the small-angle regime undergoes simple harmonic motion. The
restoring force is proportional to the displacement, producing sinusoidal
oscillation. The period depends on the length of the pendulum and the local
gravitational acceleration, but not on the amplitude for small angles.

## Overfitting note

Fitting a high-degree polynomial to oscillation data can match training points
while failing catastrophically outside the sampled interval, an example of
overfitting that does not generalise.
